editorial_thesis: The useful shift today is from an undifferentiated model endpoint to an accountable operating layer: identity, cost, traces, state, and design-system context now travel with agent work.

topic_groups.title: Attributed AI Operations
topic_groups.selection_rationale: Fresh primary releases make per-user spend, identity, and request-level tracing practical; this is a coverage gap after yesterday's runtime-observability overview.

sources.title: Cloudflare AI Gateway User Insights
sources.why_selected: Adds no-setup per-user cost and anomaly signals on existing gateway traffic.
sources.usefulness: Instrument a client or Buildn agent fleet before cost and credential incidents become opaque.

sources.title: Cloudflare AI Gateway identity-aware controls
sources.why_selected: Verified Access identity can drive gateway limits, access and log filters.
sources.usefulness: Avoid trusting a client-supplied user identifier for agent budgets and audit trails.

sources.title: Vercel AI Gateway Trace Drains
sources.why_selected: Exports routing, retries, cost and latency to standard OTLP endpoints without prompt content.
sources.usefulness: Send a sampled production trace stream to the existing observability stack.

sources.title: Vercel AI Gateway on AWS Marketplace
sources.why_selected: Moves gateway procurement into an existing cloud billing and private-offer path.
sources.usefulness: A concrete client option when procurement, not API mechanics, blocks adoption.

topic_groups.title: Stateless Agent Infrastructure
topic_groups.selection_rationale: The MCP transport change has material deployment consequences and is complemented by new practical guidance for real-time session capacity.

sources.title: Google: MCP stateless transport updates
sources.why_selected: The MCP 2026-07-28 release candidate removes handshake-held transport state.
sources.usefulness: Revisit sticky sessions and Redis dependencies in remote MCP server designs.

sources.title: Google: session-aware load balancing for real-time agents
sources.why_selected: Makes active sessions a first-class capacity signal alongside QPS and CPU.
sources.usefulness: Prevent voice or browser-agent streams from being misrouted by request-only balancing.

sources.title: Visual Studio Code 1.132
sources.why_selected: Introduces a dedicated agent host and a window for monitoring multiple agent sessions.
sources.usefulness: A practical local control surface for parallel Copilot, Claude, or Codex work.

topic_groups.title: Design Context for Agent Delivery
topic_groups.selection_rationale: A new measured Figma result fills a neglected connection between design-system maintenance and coding-agent reliability.

sources.title: Figma: Code Connect in MCP
sources.why_selected: A controlled 27-task study reports better code quality with lower token and task cost when design components map to production code.
sources.usefulness: Treat Code Connect coverage as agent-delivery infrastructure rather than design-system documentation.

sources.title: Visual Studio Code 1.132 — integrated-browser feedback
sources.why_selected: Element-level browser comments tighten the feedback loop between a rendered UI and an active agent.
sources.usefulness: Use precise visual annotations rather than broad chat descriptions for polish passes.

topic_groups.title: Model Portfolio Trials
topic_groups.selection_rationale: New model availability and a time-boxed price change justify controlled trials, not a recurring model-news roundup.

sources.title: DeepSeek V4 Flash 90% discount via Novita
sources.why_selected: The discounted window ends August 11 and supports a low-cost workload-specific trial.
sources.usefulness: Run a bounded regression suite against a cheap alternate route before the deadline.

sources.title: Qwen 3.8 Max on Vercel AI Gateway
sources.why_selected: Adds a 1M-context text-and-vision model to a unified gateway and coding-agent setup flow.
sources.usefulness: Test visual QA or design-to-page workloads under one governed API.

sources.title: Muse Spark 1.2 on Vercel AI Gateway
sources.why_selected: A coding-focused long-horizon model update is available behind the same routing and cost controls.
sources.usefulness: Compare multi-round migration or debugging tasks against the incumbent harness.
